item.text: I’ll query the workspace through the LixRay SQL API and return only Markdown files whose parent directory is exactly `/docs`, sorted by name.

statements.sql: SELECT path FROM lix_file WHERE path LIKE '/docs/%' AND instr(substr(path, length('/docs/') + 1), '/') = 0 ORDER BY path COLLATE NOCASE, path;
SELECT path FROM lix_file WHERE path LIKE '/docs/%' AND instr(substr(path, length('/docs/') + 1), '/') = 0 ORDER BY path COLLATE NOCASE, path;
